mapper.insert: INSERT INTO assessment_learning_evidence (student_user_id, knowledge_code, evidence_type, title, score_percent, confidence, reference_id, detail_json, created_time) VALUES (#{studentUserId}, #{knowledgeCode}, #{evidenceType}, #{title}, #{scorePercent}, #{confidence}, #{referenceId}, #{detailJson}, #{createdTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
